badDate: Invalid date. Use dd/mm/yyyy, just the year (1900), or "about 1900", "before 1900", "after 1900".
confirmDelete: The person and all their facts will be deleted, and they will be removed from every family they belong to.
confirmDeleteFact: This fact will be permanently deleted.
confirmDeleteUnion: The union (the family record) will be deleted. No person is deleted.
confirmUnlink: Only the family link is removed — no person is deleted.
ctaLead: Full screen: pan, zoom and jump between relatives.
ctxError: Could not load the edit data. Try again.
dangerZoneIntro: These actions are irreversible once approved. Use them with care.
dropHint: Or drag & drop an image here
factEmpty: Fill in at least one field.
familyTabHint: You can also use the + button on any tree card.
fanRecenter: Center the fan on this person
fanRerootHere: Make this person the centre of the fan
graphLoadError: The tree could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
kinshipError: The relationship could not be loaded.
kinshipNone: No relationship could be found between them.
linkChildNeedsFamily: This person has no family yet. Create the child with "New person" — that also creates the family.
linkNoFamily: The chosen person has no editable family to link through — use "New person" instead.
linkParentsFull: Both parents already exist. To link another parent, edit the family in webtrees.
nameRequired: Enter at least a given name or a surname.
needParentFirst: Add a father or mother first; siblings are added to the parents’ family.
notEditable: You do not have permission to edit this person.
opAuthLost: You have been signed out — log in and try again
opCsrf: Session expired — reload the page and try again
opError: The change could not be saved
opTimeout: The server is taking too long. Check the record to see whether the change was saved before trying again.
pngTooBig: The image is too large to export. Try the SVG format instead.
printBigTree: The tree is very large and will be printed shrunk onto one sheet. “Save image” usually gives a better result. Print anyway?
reRooted: Tree re-centred on %s — use ← to go back
replaceAlreadyMember: That person already belongs to this family.
searchFailed: The search failed. Please try again.
searchMoreHint: There are more results: also type the surname
secondFamilyConfirm: This person already has a father and a mother. If you continue, a second family will be created (for example, an adoptive one). Are you sure you want to add another parent?
secondFamilyNotice: Both parents already exist — this will create a second family for this person.
serverError: Server error — please try again in a moment
slotTaken: That family already has both spouses.
tutEditText: The + button under each card adds parents, partners or children. Tapping a union line lets you edit or remove that relationship — nothing is final until it is approved.
tutLegendText: Blue is a man, pink is a woman, and gold marks the selected person. Dashed cards are people not yet recorded.
tutLegendTextMobile: Blue is a man, pink is a woman, and gold marks the selected person. Dashed cards are people not yet recorded.
tutMoveText: Drag the background with your finger or the mouse to travel through your family.
tutSearchText: Type a name in the search box (highlighted) and jump straight to that person, wherever they are in the tree.
tutTapText: Tap any card to see that person's details: dates, photos and family. The tree rearranges around whoever you choose — the arrows at the top take you back.
tutTapTextMobile: Tap any card and open “Details” (bottom left) to see that person: dates, photos and family. The arrows at the top take you back.
tutZoomText: Use the mouse wheel, pinch with two fingers, or tap twice. The + and − buttons (highlighted) also work, and the house button re-frames the whole tree.
unionHasChildren: This union has children and cannot be deleted whole. Remove each member individually instead.
